Technical Documentation

XML Export Structure

Estimated reading: 1 minute 900 views

Our XML export structure allows seamless integration with many Multiple Listing Services (MLS), ensuring your property data is accurately and efficiently shared across platforms. The export format includes all essential property details, such as listing information, images, pricing, and descriptions.

For additional details or specific requirements, please raise a support ticket. Our team is here to assist you with any further customization or information you may need.
